verdict.rationale: Lambda has no native automation, trigger, or scheduled-job feature. Users can still assemble background automation from building blocks: the REST Cloud API launches instances programmatically, cloud-init runs launch-time configuration, and Managed Slurm schedules queued workloads automatically. The only agent-driven automation evidenced is an unofficial community CLI/MCP server. Missing for 10: a first-party scheduler or cron/trigger-based automations, event webhooks for compute resources (webhooks cover only support tickets), official agent tooling, and hands-on corroboration of unattended background workflows.
